title: Gradient-based Sample Selection for Faster Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2504.07742v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is an effective technique for black-box optimization. However, its applicability is typically limited to moderate-budget problems due to the cubic complexity of fitting the Gaussian process (GP) surrogate model. In large-budget scenarios, directly employing the standard GP model faces significant challenges in computational time and resource requirements. In this paper, we propose a novel approach, gradient-based sample selection Bayesian Optimization (GSSBO), to enhance the computational efficiency of BO. The GP model is constructed on a selected set of samples instead of the whole dataset. These samples are selected by leveraging gradient information to remove redundancy while preserving diversity and representativeness. translated_title: 基于梯度的样本选择以加速贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化（BO）是一种有效的黑箱优化技术。然而，由于拟合高斯过程（GP）代理模型的立方复杂度，其适用性通常限于中等预算的问题。在大型预算场景中，直接使用标准GP模型在计算时间和资源需求方面面临重大挑战。本文提出了一种新方法，即基于梯度的样本选择贝叶斯优化（GSSBO），以提高BO的计算效率。GP模型构建在选定的样本子集上，而非整个数据集。这些样本通过利用梯度信息来移除冗余，同时保留多样性和代表性。我们对基于梯度的样本选择策略进行了理论分析，并为所提出的框架获得了明确的次线性遗憾界。在合成和真实数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在保持优化性能的同时显著降低了计算成本。
tldr: 提出了一种基于梯度信息选择代表性样本的贝叶斯优化方法，在降低计算复杂度的同时保持优化性能，并提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: A gradient-based sample selection method for Bayesian optimization that reduces computational cost while maintaining optimization performance, with theoretical guarantees.
